name: orcheo-desktop-tauri
description: Cross-platform Tauri shell for Orcheo Studio and local Orcheo services

scripts.build: npm run build:prepare && tauri build && npm run finalize:macos-bundle
scripts.build:app: npm run build:prepare && tauri build --bundles app && npm run finalize:macos-bundle -- --skip-dmg
scripts.build:dmg: npm run build:prepare && tauri build --bundles app,dmg && npm run finalize:macos-bundle
scripts.build:prepare: npm run check:prereqs && npm run build:studio && npm run prepare:resources
scripts.dev: npm run check:prereqs && npm run build:studio && npm run prepare:resources && tauri dev
